correctness.rationale: For positive trajectories weighted logarithmic identity d log(u*v^p)/dt = u/(m+u) -(e-B)-(h+B)u is exact and checked symbolically. Positive equilibria are roots a<b of an explicit quadratic; Jacobian determinant sign distinguishes saddle (a,va) and attracting (b,vb), boundary (0,v0) is a sink. Dulac multiplier 1/(u^2*v^2) yields negative divergence (e-s-delta*(u+v)-u^2/(m+u)^2)/(u^2 v^2) under e<s, ruling out cycles while positivity and boundedness constrain omega-limits. The northwest stable branch moves monotonically backward in u downward and v upward and cannot terminate at a finite boundary equilibrium, giving a full graph psi for V>=va; strong cooperativity separates basin outcomes. Along branch, d log(psi(V)V^p)/dV is positive and O(V^-2), so H->finite positive C; integration of E/((s+delta)V^2)+O(V^(-2-p)) produces the explicit relative 1/V correction. Three numerical RK4 parameter examples and rational identity checks corroborate, not replace the planar proof.
